lyrics:
[Intro: rubbery organ bass, piano stabs, crisp hi-hat]

[Verse 1: cool deadpan female voice]
Somebody asked me what's so good
About the one on the end
I tried to tell them, never could
It's a thing you can't explain

[Chorus: full 90s house groove, voice doubled]
It's like ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba
Cabana nine
Ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba
Come by sometime
I can't describe it, I just know the sign
Ba-da-ba, cabana nine

[Drop: organ bass and piano, vocal chop]
Ba-da, ba-da (nine)

[Verse 2: deadpan, hi-hats opening]
Curtain's striped, the fan goes round
Ice is always full
Maybe it's the way the sound
Comes over from the pool

[Chorus: full 90s house groove, voice doubled]
It's like ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba
Cabana nine
Ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba
Come by sometime
I can't describe it, I just know the sign
Ba-da-ba, cabana nine

[Break: bass and claps only, spoken]
Ask for me at the desk. They'll know.

[Final Chorus: full groove, piano an octave up]
It's like ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba
Cabana nine
Ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba
Come by sometime
I can't describe it, I just know the sign
Ba-da-ba, cabana nine

[Outro: organ bass alone, a fan whirring]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 126 BPM, 4/4, G minor. A bouncy, bright, early-1990s house groove, cheerful with a straight face.

VOICE: Female, cool, flat and nearly spoken, with a slight accent and no vibrato. Doubled in the choruses. The nonsense syllables are sung on one or two notes. One dry spoken line in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A rubbery organ-style bass playing a hooky riff, bright house piano stabs, a punchy four-on-the-floor kick, crisp open and closed hi-hats, a snappy clap, a string-machine pad, a short vocal chop.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, organ bass and piano. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:04 Drop. 1:20 Verse 2. 1:44 Chorus 2. 2:08 Break, bass and claps. 2:20 Final chorus. 2:44 Outro, bass and a fan, ends 2:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: A 2023 take on 1992 house: clean and punchy, organ bass loud and round, piano bright, voice dry.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first 'ba-da-ba, ba-da-ba, cabana nine' at 0:40.

STATION FIT: 4:30 p.m., the day's peak. The fastest track in the pack, still light and playful enough for a pool deck.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Offhand, amused, inviting, in on the joke.
